MissionSettings.Blurb: Liao Intelligence has located a large Steiner production facility located in a remote region of the planet. Agents were sent in to ascertain exactly what Renard was manufacturing there. They discovered that the factories were producing a new type of tracked vehicle, the Legion Tank. Heavily armed and armored, the Legion has the capability to defeat a 'Mech in combat. Lady Cho has deemed this mission a top priority: If sufficient numbers of these tanks are produced, they could dramatically tip the scales in Steiner's favor. To ensure success, Liao Intel has leaked the location and purpose of the production facility to Baxter and the partisan forces. Agents have confirmed that the partisans are massing to attack the facility and should provide a significant distraction for your own mission.
